name: Snorkeling, Dolphin Watching & Sandbank Package
notes: Source: icomtours.com/excursions/sandbank; TripAdvisor reviews for 'iCom Tours' (Maafushi Island). Confirmed real, well-reviewed Maafushi-based excursion operator. A 4-stop package (snorkeling at two spots, dolphin watching, sandbank) is advertised at $25/person with life jacket, fins, mask, snack and drink included. Duration not stated in snippets reviewed (some iCom listings describe a separate, longer 'full day' tour with dolphin bay/shark bay/sandbank/coral garden snorkeling at a different price) so left null rather than guessed.

name: Sunset Dolphin Cruise
notes: Source: nivakurumba.com/experience/dolphin-exploration-cruise/; makemytrip.global pricing listing. Kurumba Maldives' (now mid-rebrand to 'Niva Kurumba Maldives') own sunset cruise searching for Spinner and Bottlenose dolphins in North Male Atoll. Duration ~2 hours (120 min) and adult price $65 corroborated across sources; child pricing tiers exist down to age 2, but that reflects pricing structure rather than a confirmed minimum-age policy, so min_age left null rather than inferred.

name: Sandbank Picnic
notes: Source: HolidayVibe Maldives (holiday.com.mv) Kurumba Maldives excursions page. A private/small-group picnic on a secluded sandbank near Kurumba Maldives, explicitly described as 'recommended for ages 10 years and above.' Price and duration not found in snippets reviewed; left null.

name: Malé Guided Tour
notes: Source: HolidayVibe Maldives Kurumba Maldives excursions listing; guest reviews on Tripadvisor for 'Niva Kurumba Maldives' describing a guided tour of Male' city run 9am-12pm (3 hours = 180 min). Some higher villa categories reportedly receive this tour complimentary. Price not found in snippets reviewed; left null. Kurumba also lists a separate, distinct 'Cultural Island Experience' excursion that was not individually verified with enough detail to add as its own entry.

name: Private Surf Lesson (Cokes)
operator_name: The Perfect Wave Cokes Surf Camp
notes: Source: surfcamp-online.com listing for 'The Perfect Wave Cokes Surfcamp' (Thulusdhoo, Maldives), operated by Brian James; corroborated by cokessurfcampmaldives.com and Tripadvisor reviews. Private surf lesson pricing: $75/hour for 1 person, $120 for 2, $150 for 3-4 (base $75 used as price_from). The camp sits directly on the 'Cokes' surf break (North Male Atoll, so named for a nearby Coca-Cola bottling plant). Reviews describe the main break as unsuitable for true beginners even though lessons are offered to guests of varying levels, so difficulty was left null rather than picking one value.

name: Discover Scuba Diving (DSD)
notes: Source: maafushidive.com/products/discover-scuba-diving. A PADI Discover Scuba Diving program for first-time/non-certified divers, run by 'Maafushi Dive and Water Sports' (a 5-Star PADI Gold Palm dive centre on Maafushi Island, Kaafu Atoll). Confirmed price $75/person; participants check in at 1:30pm and join the centre's afternoon diving trip, but total session length in minutes was not stated, so duration left null. difficulty recorded as beginner since the program is explicitly designed for people who have never dived before.

name: PADI Open Water Diver Course
notes: Source: maafushidive.com/collections/diving/products/open-water-course and maafushidive.com/collections/dive-courses. Full PADI Open Water certification course: $475/person, includes student materials, equipment rental, boat charges and certification fees; described as a 3-day course (5 theory modules, 5 confined-water sessions, 4 open-water dives). duration_minutes left null since the course spans multiple days rather than a single timed session; the 3-day structure is noted here instead.

name: Private Snorkeling Trip
notes: Source: maafushidive.com/pages/snorkeling. A private guided snorkeling trip ('with nemos and turtles') priced at $150. The same operator also lists a pricier 'snorkeling with sharks' option ($350) and a sandbank-picnic snorkeling combo ($225); only the base private trip was added to avoid padding near-duplicate listings from one page. Duration, difficulty and max participants not stated in snippets reviewed; left null.

name: Private Dolphin Cruise
notes: Source: activemaldives.com/dolphin-cruise; Tripadvisor listing/reviews for 'Active Watersports Maafushi'. Confirmed real Maafushi-based water-sports operator running a 60-minute private dolphin-watching cruise for up to 2 people. Price not found in the snippets reviewed (a dedicated price-list page exists on the operator's site but its figures were not returned by search); left null.

name: Full-Day Snorkeling & Island Hopping Tour
notes: Source: Viator listing 'Maafushi: Full day Snorkeling and Island hopping experience' (viator.com/tours/Maafushi-Island/...d50612-154002P58); corroborated by general Maafushi island-hopping coverage naming Gulhi and Guraidhoo as common stops. Priced at $90/person ($180 for 2). Booked through the Viator marketplace rather than a single named local tour company that could be confidently identified as the operating entity, so operator_name left null. Duration described only as 'full day' (no specific hour count), left null.

name: Sandbank, Snorkeling & Dolphin Watching Excursions
notes: Source: visitmaldives.com news piece 'Kaani Hotels & Tours: Redefining Summer Holidays in the Maldives'; Tripadvisor listing for 'Kaani Tours' (Maafushi Island); Tripadvisor review of Kaani Beach Hotel mentioning bookable excursions. Kaani Tours is described as the excursion arm of the Kaani Hotels group (which also runs Kaani Beach Hotel, already in accommodations.json under operator_name 'Kaani Hotels'), offering diving, snorkeling, local-island visits, sandbank lunches and dolphin watching to guests. operator_name set to the exact existing provider string 'Kaani Hotels' to link to that record. No single confirmed price or duration for a specific package; left null. As with the Kaani Hotels accommodation record, this is brand-level confidence rather than a confirmed registered-company match (see Known Gaps in accommodations SOURCES.md).

name: Guided Reef Dive
notes: Source: baros.com/divers-baros-maldives/diving; padi.com dive-center listing for 'Divers Baros Maldives'; baros.com dive brochure PDF. Confirmed real, long-established (opened 1979) PADI Five Star Gold Palm dive centre based at Baros Maldives, North Male Atoll, running twice-daily trips to 30+ dive sites within ~50 minutes by boat, plus night diving. It was the first Reef Check-certified EcoDive Centre in the Maldives. This is the dive centre's own operator identity, distinct from (and not confidently tied to) Baros Maldives' own accommodation operator, which is left null in accommodations.json. Price, duration and difficulty level for a single dive not found in snippets reviewed; left null.

name: Sunset Dolphin Cruise
notes: Source: soneva.com/experience/sunset-dolphin-cruise/. Soneva Fushi's own cruise looking for dolphins with a seasonal chance of also spotting manta rays or pilot whales; described as combined with 'castaway life'/sandbank time. Price and duration not stated in the snippet reviewed; left null.

name: Soneva Soul 60-Minute Spa Treatment
notes: Source: search summary citing Soneva Fushi spa pricing (Soneva Soul wellness brand, soneva.com/soneva-soul/our-spas/ and soneva.com/experience/soneva-soul-spa-soneva-fushi/). A 60-minute treatment is priced at USD 195 plus 12% government tax and 10% service charge (those surcharges are not reflected in price_from, which records the base treatment price only). Soneva Soul offers Ayurvedic remedies, massage, body treatments, vitamin therapy and more; only the base 60-minute treatment price was recorded rather than the full menu.

name: Traditional Handline Fishing Trip
notes: Source: sixsenses.com excursions/experiences pages for Six Senses Laamu (Laamu Atoll, the resort's own island Olhuveli). Fishing trips are listed among the resort's bookable excursions, including 'big game, night fishing, and traditional handline fishing.' Only the traditional handline option was recorded here as the most distinct/local-style trip; price and duration not found in snippets reviewed, left null.

name: Night Fishing Excursion
notes: Source: velassaru.com/experiences/ and related aMaldives/Turquoise Holidays coverage of Niva Velassaru Maldives' activity offering, which lists 'big game fishing and night fishing excursions' allowing guests to try traditional fishing methods, run through the resort's own Immersion Dive and Watersports Centre. Price and duration not found in snippets reviewed; left null.
